The action of clicking the 'Add Sort' button triggered a change in the status region, which now displays the message 'New sort order condition added, 2 of 2'. This indicates that the system has successfully registered a new sort configuration, preparing the interface to accept the specific field for sorting.

Continuing the workflow to sort the asset list by 'Asset function', the agent is now selecting the specific field to apply as the sorting criteria. This step opens the field selection menu to define the order of the assets.
